findings.title: Policy on "notes" does not restrict rows (SELECT open to anon, authenticated)
findings.fixPrompt:
Fix one critical security issue that DeployReady found in this project.

Where: supabase/migrations/20240201000000_notes.sql:8
Issue: Policy on "notes" does not restrict rows (SELECT open to anon, authenticated) (CWE-285, A01:2025)
What to change: Scope the policy to the row owner or tenant, e.g. USING ((select auth.uid()) = user_id) / WITH CHECK ((select auth.uid()) = user_id), or org membership with a correctly qualified join (m.org_id = <table>.org_id). A role check such as auth.role() = 'authenticated' is not an ownership check. If the table is meant to be public, add it to "publicTables" in .deployready.json.

Keep the fix minimal: change only what this issue needs, do not change behaviour or refactor unrelated code, and never put real secrets in code or in your reply (use environment variables).
To confirm: re-run `npx deployready@latest analyze` and check this issue is gone, or call the DeployReady MCP `verify` tool with id "deb39f443450".
